title: SpecificationPublished.v1 domain event
description: Published by specification-service through the outbox in the same transaction as the release. Aggregate = the supplier material's specification series: aggregateId is the materialId and aggregateVersion the released versionNumber, so consumers discard stale versions. Consumers: Formulation (released-spec projection), Compliance (Phase 1 POTENTIAL findings), Notification (Should). Owner: M1 (G0-M1.5).
